text.answer: Skarner is a tank/fighter who charges through terrain to grab enemies and drags suppressed champions with Impale. His boulder attacks deal physical damage, Quaking deals maximum-health magic damage over time, and his shield scales with his maximum health.
text.counterplay: Watch terrain approaches, keep space from allies, and avoid being caught with a wall behind you.

text.answer: Skarner accelerates through terrain while immune to slows, grabbing and suppressing an enemy champion or large monster he collides with. Driving the grabbed target into terrain deals physical damage, stuns them, and reduces this ability's cooldown. Immobilizing, grounding, or cast-inhibiting crowd control ends the charge and detaches the target.
text.counterplay: Watch terrain approaches, avoid lining up with nearby walls, and use charge-interrupting crowd control when available.

citations.quote: Skarner charges in the target direction for a duration while ignoring terrain collision and gaining ghosting and slow immunity. He starts slowly but ramps up in movement speed over the course of the charge

Colliding with an enemy champion or large monster causes Skarner to increase his movement speed, forcibly grab them to attach them to him, and suppress them while dragging them along for the remainder of the charge.

facts.claim: Skarner accelerates through terrain while immune to slows, grabbing and suppressing an enemy champion or large monster he collides with.

citations.quote: If the attached target collides with terrain while grabbed, they are stunned and dealt physical damage, ending the charge, and reducing Ixtal's Impact cooldown.
